lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Ga2Co2 (reduced formula Li2GaCo) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Co and Ga centers each have 8 Li neighbors, while Li centers have 4 Ga and 4 Co neighbors, all at 2.5042 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Li–Li and Co–Ga 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face types, with Co–Co and Ga–Ga polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
